# Audifort

> Audifort is a Health & Fitness > Brain & Memory > Ear & Hearing Wellness Supplement. Audifort is a modern herbal dietary supplement formulated to support ear health, hearing wellness and everyday auditory comfort. Rather than a stimulant or a prescription-style product, it is a daily capsule built around plant-based and nutrient ingredients traditionally associated with healthy circulation, nerve support and normal auditory function. Taken as part of a consistent routine, Audifort is positioned for adults who want to look after their ears and hearing as part of a broader brain-and-body wellness plan.
